text:
Rae: Quick readout: 6/7 testers clicked the quickstart banner then expected a checklist. The slim left rail didn’t signal a step-by-step flow.
Ben: lab confirms. Rail = low friction but low clarity. Modal = clear but blocks exploration.
Maya: metric: onboarding completion dipped after rail rollout. CTA copy likely ambiguous.
A11yBot: accessibility: current rail CTA contrast 3.7:1 (fail). Keyboard nav skips CTA. Needs tabindex + contrast.
Rae: Proposal: keep rail as default, add a compact 3-bullet preview under CTA (Invite team; Deploy sample; Run a test prompt) and a “Full setup” link that opens the modal checklist.
Ben: Copy A/B: "Create demo project" (explicit) vs "Start setup checklist". Leaning to explicit. Add microcopy: "Sandbox with examples — ~2 min."
Maya: Telemetry/events: quickstart_rail_click, quickstart_preview_open, quickstart_modal_open, quickstart_rail_dismiss. Experiment: hide rail for 14 days after dismiss.
A11yBot: Quick fixes: role="region" + aria-label on rail, ensure CTA reachable with single Tab, visible focus ring, bump contrast >=4.5:1. CSS suggestion: `.rail-cta{outline:3px solid var(--focus); color:#06204a}`
Ben: Eng estimate ~3 dev days (copy, tabindex, contrast, telemetry). Modal reuse minimal.
Rae: OK — I'll make the ticket, attach Figma + a11y notes, and run A/B for copy. Reconvene after ticket triage. :thumbsup:
